premise: A bottle washes up with a note inside saying 'Hello from far away'; Lola and Nico draw their beach and send it back out to sea.
inspiration: The message-in-a-bottle motif of sea tales, with no shipwreck and no treasure: the treasure is a hello from a stranger, and saying hello back.
lesson: A friendly hello can travel a long way.
learning: A bottle can float a long, long way across the sea.

en-US.title: Hello From Far Away
en-US.text: {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gull saw it first: something green, bobbing out on the water. {seagull:live} She squawked and squawked. {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} A bottle! A wave carried it right up to the water's edge. {girl:enter} Lola came running, {surfer:enter} and Nico too. {girl:go to bottle} {surfer:go to bottle} {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] "There's a note inside!" {bottle:live hold} Pop! Out came the cork, and the note peeked out. {surfer:face surprised} Lola unrolled it: a drawing of a smiling fish, and three words. {girl:says} [softly] "Hello from far away." {bottle:glow 0.5} [in awe] That bottle had floated a long, long way, for weeks and weeks, over the water, just to say hello. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] "Let's say hello back!" So they drew their own beach, with a castle and a kite, {bottle:live resume} rolled it up, and pushed in the cork. Nico gave the bottle a gentle push, {bottle:go away left} and off it bobbed. {girl:face happy} {seagull:hop} [softly] Somewhere far away, someone will find it, and smile.

es-ES.title: Hola desde muy lejos
es-ES.text: {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota lo vio la primera: algo verde que se mecía en el agua. {seagull:live} Graznó y graznó. {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} ¡Una botella! Una ola la dejó justo en la orilla. {girl:enter} Lola llegó corriendo, {surfer:enter} y Nico también. {girl:go to bottle} {surfer:go to bottle} {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Hay una nota dentro!» {bottle:live hold} ¡Pop! Saltó el corcho, y la nota asomó. {surfer:face surprised} Lola la desenrolló: un dibujo de un pez sonriente, y unas palabras. {girl:says} [softly] «Hola desde muy lejos.» {bottle:glow 0.5} [in awe] Aquella botella había flotado muchísimo, durante semanas y semanas, sobre el agua, solo para decir hola. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Vamos a contestar!» Así que dibujaron su propia playa, con un castillo y una cometa, {bottle:live resume} lo enrollaron y pusieron el corcho. Nico le dio a la botella un empujoncito, {bottle:go away left} y allá se fue, meciéndose. {girl:face happy} {seagull:hop} [softly] Muy lejos, alguien la encontrará, y sonreirá.
